facts.anchor: THX, BYE is spelled out in Cheetos on the coffee table
facts.fact: Lucy 早上醒来发现 Saskia 已离开，毯子盖在她身上、电视关掉，咖啡桌上用 Cheetos 拼出「THX, BYE」。

facts.anchor: No wonder her grandfather wouldn’t let her watch anything but the Disney Channel.
facts.fact: Lucy 认为自己被《Jennifer’s Body》改变了，并想到祖父只准她看迪士尼频道。

facts.anchor: Her chicken soup recipe is liquid penicillin.
facts.fact: Lucy 决定给（以为生病的）Saskia 熬鸡汤，用的是曾祖母的食谱。

facts.anchor: But when she reaches her street, she sees a vehicle in the short driveway
facts.fact: Lucy 骑车买菜回家，在自家车道上看到一辆本不该出现的车——警车。
两名警察（Dover 与 Peyton）先在门廊同 Saskia 交谈，随后叫住骑车回来的 Lucy。

facts.anchor: The new owners brought in some landscapers, and they found a body.
facts.fact: Dover 告诉 Lucy：249 Durant Avenue 的新房主请园艺工来，后者发现了一具尸体。

facts.anchor: I was only fourteen. My grandfather got super strict after she disappeared.
facts.fact: Lucy 说母亲失踪时自己只有十四岁，祖父此后把她锁在家里。

facts.anchor: There is a knife blade stuck in her fingernail.
facts.fact: Lucy 切胡萝卜时刀扎进指甲，因没有急救箱，她下楼去 Saskia 家求助。
